title: NeMo Guardrails checks for NeMo Relay
description: Checks tool calls and tool results with the /v1/checks/input and /v1/checks/output endpoints of a NeMo Guardrails server.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the NeMo Guardrails server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000.

config_id.description: Guardrails configuration to check against. It must name a configuration loaded on the server.

headers.description: Headers sent with every check, for a proxy or gateway in front of the Guardrails server, such as authorization. Values are treated as sensitive.

timeout_millis.description: Time limit for one check, in milliseconds. Keep it under the host's hook limit: 1500 or less in gateway modes, about 25000 in daemon mode.

priority.description: NeMo Relay execution-intercept priority. Lower values run further out.

executor.description: Optional NeMo Relay SDK executor override.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for the plugin's SDK-owned executor.
